summary: Frontend-only testing of the 4 new features (Fate Recap page, check-in weekly streak surfacing, TrophiesPill recap entry, heartbeat/ShakeHint regression). Recap data crunching, slide set, navigation and scope toggle all verified correct with empty and seeded localStorage (24 journal entries, checkins, ff_checkin_weeks, best streak 9). Week-streak survival/expiry logic verified. Home page, /secrets, /journal load with zero console/page errors. ONE HIGH bug found: the finale slide's 'Share my recap' and 'Deal a fate' controls are completely unclickable (tap-zone overlays intercept pointer events) on mobile AND desktop.

ui_bugs.issue: Share my recap and Deal a fate are un-clickable. The slide container at line 205 has 'relative z-0', which creates a stacking context, so the inner 'relative z-20' button wrapper (line 236) can never rise above the tap-zone buttons (z-10, lines 202-203). document.elementFromPoint at the buttons' centers returns recap-tap-prev (mobile) / recap-tap-next (desktop); Playwright normal clicks time out at 390x844 and 1920x1080. Only force=True works. Fix: drop z-0 from the content wrapper (or give the tap zones a lower z / pointer-events-none on the finale slide).
'TAP TO CONTINUE' hint still shows on the finale slide even though there is nothing further to advance to (tap-next is clamped). Minor polish.

When navigator.share is absent AND clipboard.writeText is rejected (permission denied / non-user-gesture), the catch block is silent — user gets no feedback at all. Observed 0 toasts in headless Chrome. Suggest a fallback error toast.

action_items: Fix z-index/stacking on Recap finale: remove 'z-0' from the slide content container (Recap.jsx line 205) so recap-share-button and recap-deal-again become clickable (verify with a normal, non-force Playwright click).
Optional: hide 'Tap to continue' on the finale slide and add a fallback toast when share/clipboard both fail.
critical_code_review_comments: Recap.jsx: full-bleed tap-zone buttons (z-10) overlaying interactive finale content inside a z-0 stacking context is the root cause of the dead buttons; prefer pointer-events-none on tap zones when slide.finale is true.
Recap.jsx useMemo for stats intentionally omits `now` from deps with an eslint-disable — acceptable, but stats will not refresh across a midnight/month boundary while the page stays open.

lib/points.js claimCheckin: weekly bonus is awarded before the base check-in award, so the returned `total` correctly includes both; logic verified. readCheckinWeekStreak correctly expires a streak whose latest week is neither the current nor previous Monday.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 checks passed; finale CTA clickability failed)

seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded via page.evaluate on the app origin: ff_journal (24 synthetic entries, mixed cuisines Tacos/Pizza/Sushi, themes dark/tiki, dares, verdicts, dates in current month + March 2026), ff_points_streak_best=9, ff_checkins={a:2026-04-11,b:today}, ff_checkin_weeks={week:<current Monday>,streak:3} and a stale-week variant. All cleared between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page gating order on a fresh origin: parchment-intro ('Enter the realms') -> theme-welcome realm chooser (click first realm button) -> mode-chooser-solo -> guided-flow ('Skip intro'). Only then is header-trophies-pill clickable. Verified year-scope slide order with seeded data: intro, total(24/15 unique), cuisine(Tacos 15x), verdict(79%, 24 judged), dares(4), realm(Reaper's Domain 18), streaks(9 day best + 2 GPS check-ins [+ '3 week check-in run going' when ff_checkin_weeks week == current Monday]), finale. Month toggle resets to slide 1 and recomputes (8 fates for September 2026). Zero console errors across recap/home/secrets/journal.
rca_of_the_issue: Recap.jsx line 205 wraps the AnimatePresence slide content in `relative z-0`, forming a stacking context whose descendants are capped at z-index 0 relative to siblings; the absolute tap-zone buttons (z-10, lines 202-203) therefore paint above the finale's `relative z-20` CTA row, intercepting all pointer events. Reproduce: open /recap, tap to finale, run document.elementFromPoint on the Share button center -> returns recap-tap-prev/next; Playwright normal click times out. Mitigation: remove z-0 (or set the content wrapper to z-20+ as a sibling of the tap zones) / disable pointer events on tap zones for the finale slide.
